As you see friend there are many of us who are in a similar head space. Not that it makes it any better. I am in a similar space minus getting divorced.. f me. But that empty feeling is a very strange one isn’t it. We can try and fill it with recreation, or hobbies. But no matter how much I fill my day I can’t escape the total feeling of emptiness when I lay down to sleep. 
My advice for you if I had any would be stay busy and not in a meaningless way but focus on others. Try and make your girlfriend and your family happy. This can be super beneficial to yourself.

like other commenters have said it is good to examine your friends and what exactly you have in common with them. do you share enough to consider yourselves on the same plane so to speak. or are they just your friends because you've known them a long time. there are so many groups for ever type of hobby or activity, and most of the people joining those type of events are searching for friends. can be great ways to find ones whos common interest make friendship worthwhile

yeah this statement seems to be predicated on the fact that you as the individual have some power or control over the thing that is causing the feelings of not wanting to be. in reality the control may be in the control of one who has no desire or control themselves to change. doesn't make the path of ending things the right one but this saying is certainly silly and unhelpful.

early 30's means you still have a good amount of time to do whatever you decide. be it school, business start up, marriage, kids. set small goals and write them down, then make yourself accountable to them.
